title: Add the assets you follow
next: Next: build your first Signal Group
intro_say: Angstrom Signals. | Day one: add the assets you follow.
outro_say: That's your watchlist set up. | Next, your first Signal Group.

steps.screen: A card: your watchlists decide what you see
steps.say: Your watchlists decide what the dashboard shows: the signal tables, the chart, and your scans. | Let's set them up.
First, open Settings in the sidebar and choose the markets you trade: cryptos, equities, or both. | The other market's sections hide.

steps.screen: Ticking the first step of the checklist
steps.say: Then tick that step on the getting-started checklist.
Now open Watchlists, then Edit Crypto. | Type a name or a ticker, press Enter, and pick the match. | Here, Chainlink.
Shares work the same way, in Edit Stocks. | Type a company or a ticker. Here, AMD.

steps.screen: The new assets in the signal tables
steps.say: Both now appear in the signal tables, with their Trend, Stretch and Flow readings.
To take one off, choose it under Remove, in the same place.
Three or more assets ticks the watchlist step by itself. | Your watchlists are saved on your account, on every device.
